documents: Proof you lived outside the EU, e.g. deregistration certificate (Abmeldebescheinigung)
Or employer or embassy letter confirming a planned stay abroad of 12+ months
German address registration (Anmeldebestätigung), if you have it
Rental contract and employment contract, if relevant
Signed note that no firearms, alcohol, tobacco, tea or coffee are packed
dutyFree: You lived outside the EU for over 12 months, or planned to
Goods and vehicles owned and used by you for at least 6 months
Goods arrive within 12 months of moving your main home to Germany
Goods are kept for the same use and not sold for 12 months
restricted: Alcohol and tobacco are not covered by the duty-free allowance
Weapons, ammunition, fireworks, cash, medicines and narcotics are restricted
Food, plants and animal products are restricted
Pets need a microchip, rabies vaccination and vet certificate; some dog breeds are banned
Commercial vehicles and business equipment pay duty
notes: Give the individual value of any single item worth more than EUR 5,000
Private cars must be registered to you abroad for 6 months, then pass a German technical inspection
Wooden crates must carry the ISPM 15 mark or may be inspected or treated
Only German customs can grant the duty-free entry

documents: Export declaration filed in advance through the German ATLAS customs system
dutyFree: No customs tariffs on exported household goods and personal effects
restricted: Some goods, destinations or people may face export restrictions
notes: Everything going to a country outside the EU must clear German customs
You need documents proving the goods actually left for the non-EU country
